The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. You dig into unfamiliar systems, ask precise questions, and look beyond the first plausible answer. Ownership. You care about the outcome. You want an ambitious problem and room to figure it out. You enjoy moving between unfamiliar tools, systems, and domains. You’re willing to do the less exciting work that makes a project useful: testing, documentation, rollout, and iteration. You want direct feedback and responsibility that grows with your ability. You’ll struggle here if: You need a complete specification before you can start. You’re more interested in starting projects than finishing them.
